$comment: Listing data contract. PROPOSED — not yet created in any Sharetribe environment. Changing an id/key/option value after it is created in Sharetribe is not possible; review before approval. Human-readable companion: docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md. Console 'Single-line text' fields are limited to 70 characters (Sharetribe help: listing field types).
configurationSourceOfTruth: Sharetribe Test environment (Console), copied to Dev via Console 'Copy changes to…'

listingTypes.label: Managed ride rental
listingTypes.notes: One listing type for every ride family. Categories describe the ride; the listing type describes how the customer transacts. Process choice is pending founder approval — see docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md §2.

categories.urlRule: Category ID is also the URL slug: /categories/{id}

nativeAttributes.rule: Customer-facing name of the offering, e.g. 'Ferris wheel rental'. Never implies a specific unit unless offeringScope = specific-model.
Plain description of the managed service. No invented specs, reviews, counts or certifications.
Owned or licensed images only. Provenance recorded in our catalog store.
Not used in v1 (null). Displayed estimates live in metadata.estimate*; the charge always comes from server-set line items of an accepted quote.
Never set on national offerings: a pin would imply the equipment is physically there.
Not used. A national offering is not one bookable physical unit; rider capacity is never inventory.

fields.label: Offering key (internal)
fields.meaning: Stable identity of an offering across environments, URLs and title changes.

search.reason: Our catalog store maps offerKey -> listing id per environment; reconciliation reads all house listings.

fields.frontend: Join key between Sharetribe listing and our catalog record (slug, SEO copy, provenance).
fields.pseo: Joins offering to page records; never shown.
fields.unknown: Not allowed — every offering has one.

fields.label: Offering scope
fields.meaning: Whether the offering is a general ride family ('we source a Ferris wheel') or one specific manufacturer model.
fields.frontend: Controls whether model and spec sections render at all.
fields.pseo: Ride-family offerings may appear on city pages; specific-model offerings only where their coverage allows.

fields.label: Manufacturer
fields.meaning: Ride manufacturer for a specific-model offering.
fields.frontend: Shown on the offering page when present.
fields.pseo: May appear in copy only when present; never inferred.
fields.unknown: Omit the key. Never AI-guessed. A provenance record is required in our catalog store.

fields.label: Model
fields.meaning: Manufacturer model name for a specific-model offering.
fields.frontend: Shown on the offering page when present.
fields.pseo: May appear in copy only when present; never inferred.
fields.unknown: Omit the key. Never AI-guessed. Provenance required.

fields.label: States we accept requests for
fields.meaning: US states (plus DC) where we accept sourcing requests for this offering. NOT where equipment is located and NOT date availability.

search.note: Console multi-select filters in Sharetribe's hosted template use has_all. Our frontend queries the Marketplace API directly with meta_requestableStates=has_any:… — this must be verified with sample listings before approval of search.

fields.frontend: Event-state filter: selecting TX shows offerings whose list contains TX. Selecting TX and AZ shows offerings covering TX OR AZ.
fields.pseo: A city/ride+city page lists an offering only if the city's state is in this list. Copy: 'we arrange requests for events in {city}, subject to availability'.
fields.unknown: Not allowed — an offering must state where we accept requests. 'Nationwide' is expressed as all 51 values.

fields.label: Suited event types
fields.meaning: General guidance on event types this offering usually suits. Not a guarantee of fit.
fields.frontend: Suitability chips; optional event-type filter (ANY semantics). Same option IDs as the request form's eventType.
fields.pseo: May be listed on pages; never used to generate per-event-type page families in v1.

fields.label: Pricing mode
fields.meaning: How price is presented before a quote.
fields.frontend: quote-required: 'Tailored quote'. indicative-range: 'Planning estimate $X–$Y — not a quote'. Neither ever becomes the charge.
fields.pseo: Same labels; estimate figures only when indicative-range and approved.

fields.label: Planning estimate — low (USD)
fields.meaning: Lower bound of a planning estimate, whole US dollars.
fields.unknown: Omit; pricingMode must then be quote-required.

fields.label: Planning estimate — high (USD)
fields.meaning: Upper bound of a planning estimate, whole US dollars. Must be >= estimateLowUsd.
fields.unknown: Omit; pricingMode must then be quote-required.

fields.label: Planning estimate — basis
fields.meaning: What the estimate is based on, shown next to it (e.g. 'per event, 1–3 operating days, excludes long-distance transport').
fields.unknown: Omit; pricingMode must then be quote-required.

fields.label: Height (ft)
fields.meaning: Verified overall height of the specific model.
fields.unknown: Omit the key. Never a default. Provenance record required in our catalog store.

fields.label: Riders per cycle
fields.meaning: Verified maximum riders per ride cycle. A specification — never bookable inventory.
fields.unknown: Omit the key. Never a default. Provenance required.

fields.label: Footprint length (ft)
fields.meaning: Verified site footprint length including required clearance, per manufacturer/operator documentation.

fields.label: Footprint width (ft)
fields.meaning: Verified site footprint width including required clearance.

fields.label: Power requirement
fields.meaning: Verified electrical requirement as documented (e.g. '208V 3-phase, 100A' or 'self-powered (diesel generator)').

eventTypes.rule: Identical IDs to the event request form (src/lib/requests/schema.ts eventType).

neverInListingData: supplier quotes, costs, margins, payment terms
physical unit serials, inspection records, home bases
customer event details (dates, venue, budget, contact) — these belong to the event request / transaction

storageRules.publicData: Readable by everyone; writable by the listing author (our house account) and operator. Only native template keys (listingType, transactionProcessAlias, unitType, categoryLevel1).
storageRules.metadata: Readable by everyone; writable by operator only. All contract fields live here so no author login can alter them.
storageRules.privateData: Readable by the listing author and operator. NOT used for procurement data — anyone holding the house-account login could read it.
storageRules.transactionMetadata: Visible to transaction participants (the customer). Never holds costs or margins.
storageRules.procurement: Our own database only (suppliers, units, supplier quotes, margins).
